votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the December 9 CPC meeting as submitted.
votes.quote: the committee approved the minutes of the tuesday, december 9 cpc meeting as submitted, 5-0.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting.
votes.quote: joanna made a motion to adjourn the meeting. heather seconded the motion and the committee voted 5-0 to adjourn at 6:36 pm.

votes.motion: Raise the priority of $34,000 for upgraded technology for Town Departments from 11 to priority 9.

votes.motion: Recommend that the Town fund the ten highest priority capital items, total estimated cost $1,028,778, and that the Town Manager consider borrowing for one, two or all three of the dump truck, backhoe and street sweeper.

votes.motion: Take funding for painting the Town Hall out of the recommended FY16 Capital Plan.

votes.motion: Reallocate the $40,000 allocated to paint the Town Hall to fund upgrading the schools' network and the police speed sign.
votes.quote: john seconded the motion and the committee approved the motion 4-0.

votes.motion: Apply any unspent monies to the street sweeper and/or dump truck to reduce debt service costs.
votes.quote: dennis seconded the motion and the committee voted 4-0 to approve the motion.
